title: Relay mailbox listing performs redundant association writes and can hide local results on writer contention
outcome: Listing already verified relay history avoids redundant coordination writes and does not discard independently available mailbox results because optional association caching is busy.
acceptance: A repeated listing with an unchanged association does not need a writer transaction for that association.
Focused controls distinguish authoritative home/list refusal from optional association-cache contention, retaining independent available history truthfully.
